1.4
Objectives
The major objectives of the project are as follows:
1. Design a secure authentication system using JWT and bcrypt.
2. Develop a personal workspace management module.
3. Support uploading of PDF, DOCX and TXT documents.
4. Extract textual information from uploaded documents.
5. Implement multiple document chunking strategies.
6. Generate semantic embeddings using Sentence Transformers.
7. Store document embeddings efficiently using FAISS.
8. Retrieve the most relevant document chunks based on user queries.
9. Generate grounded prompts for a local Large Language Model.
10. Produce reliable responses with automatic source citations.
11. Develop a scalable and modular backend architecture using FastAPI.
1.5
Scope of the Project
The developed system focuses on semantic document understanding and intelligent in-
formation retrieval.
The current implementation supports secure authentication, personal workspaces,
document management, semantic retrieval, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, citation
generation, and local LLM execution.
Future enhancements may include multilingual document support, cloud deployment,
collaborative workspaces, OCR for scanned documents, hybrid search, and integration
with larger language models.
1.6
Applications
The Intelligent Research Assistant has applications in several domains:
• Academic research
• Higher education
